name: recordings_update
title: Update recording metadata
description: Use this when the user wants to rename a BitterClip recording or set/replace its description or chapters. Video visual analysis is automatic; audio-only recordings skip it. This does not re-transcribe, edit media, create clips, render, or publish.

title.description: Optional new recording title. Blank titles are rejected.

description.description: Optional recording description; an empty string clears it.

chapters.description: Optional user-authored recording chapters. Each item needs start_seconds and title.

source.description: Updated source payload with title and description.

project.description: Parent project payload when the recording belongs to a project.
